newsitem.title: USA: Universal October same-store sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Universal October same-store sales fall.

text.p: Universal International Inc comparable store sales for its retail units fell 8.6 percent in October and were down three percent for the first 10 months of 1996, the company said Wednesday.
Total sales for October for its Only Deals and Odd's-N-End's retail stores rose to $5.8 million from $4.3 million in 1995, a 33.6 percent increase.
Sales for the 10 months ended October 31, 1996 increased 28.8 percent to $41.1 million from $31.9 million in 1995.

Universal International buys and sells quality "close-out" merchandise in both its wholesale business and its Only Deals and Odd's-N-End's retail store chains. Through a newly formed subsidiary, Universal Asset-Based Services Inc, it also provides inventory valuation and liquidation services.
